vecadd.test:
# Additional tests focusing on boundary/tail handling, extreme values, and dtype precision
def run_test(size, dtype=torch.float32):
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(size, dtype=dtype)
    y = torch.randn(size, dtype=dtype)
    out = add(x, y)
    assert torch.allclose(out, x + y, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5), f"fail size={size} dtype={dtype}"

# 1. single‑element tensor (tests minimal tail)
run_test(1)

# 2. size just under a block (1023) – exercises mask with non‑full block
run_test(1023)

# 3. exact block size (1024) – no mask needed
run_test(1024)

# 4. size just over a block (1025) – tests second block tail of 1 element
run_test(1025)

# 5. overflow/underflow stress test with large magnitude values
n = 2048
x = torch.full((n,), 3.4e38, dtype=torch.float32)
y = torch.full((n,), 3.4e38, dtype=torch.float32)
out = add(x, y)
assert torch.allclose(out, x + y, equal_nan=True), "overflow test failed"

# 6. float16 tail test with a size that forces multiple blocks and a tiny tail
size = 98305  # >96*1024, tail of 1 element
x = torch.randn(size, dtype=torch.float16)
y = torch.randn(size, dtype=torch.float16)
out = add(x, y)
assert torch.allclose(out, x + y, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3), "float16 tail test failed"
